dct_title_s: Preliminary satellite-derived impact assessment on health facilities, Abu Hamad City, Abu Hamad Locality, River Nile State, 2 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240826SDN, GDACS ID: 1102854** Status: Affected structures detected Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings: Flooded areas and evidence of overflow were observed in Hamad City, Abu Hamad Locality, River Nile State, on August 29, 2024. Alshorta, Alshaheed Gamal (Family Health Center), and Abu Hamad Hospital are likely affected by the floodwaters. Yashgeen (Family Health Unit) and Alsilim (Family Health Center) appear to be unaffected by the floodwaters.
